read_this_before_comparing: The 'permissions' group below is NOT a license-tier finding. Codeunits 60013 and 60827 declare 'TestPermissions = Disabled' and no 'Permissions' property, so they acquire no permission context of their own and every write falls through to whatever the license grants. The table choice (5902 / 5406 / 5957) is incidental; the missing declaration is the defect.
A dev-licensed container is expected to MASK that defect, not resolve it. A pass on those three here means nothing for them -- it is the same masking that hid the problem until a SaaS run exposed it.
The exposure is corpus-wide, not confined to these two codeunits: at 28869bc2, 185 test codeunits declare 'TestPermissions = Disabled' and exactly 2 declare 'Permissions' at all.
